name: american-dictator
description: A satirical political survival game. Four years to turn America into a dictatorship.

scripts.cap:add:ios: npm run build && npx cap add ios
scripts.cap:add:android: npm run build && npx cap add android
scripts.cap:sync: npm run build && npx cap sync
scripts.cap:ios: npm run build && npx cap sync ios && npx cap open ios
scripts.cap:android: npm run build && npx cap sync android && npx cap open android
